message: 急いては事をうとん汁

name: Synn
message: 「Only one more day until the exam, huh.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yo, Master Synn, ain't it a little early for the markdown sale?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nope, today I'm splurging and spending a whole hundred yen.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks to last night's study session, my engine's finally warmed up, even if it's a bit late. Now all I need to do is refuel with some quality gas.」

name: Paqy
message: 「...On a hundred yen?」

name: Synn
message: 「With this much, I can live like a king. Like clearance bean sprouts, or clearance fish scraps, or clearance ground meat, or clearance bananas.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You keep eatin' stuff like that and your engine's gonna misfire, y'know?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President, I know just the dish for a time like this!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa?!」
Lolotte appears out of nowhere and starts tugging me along with surprising force.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President, which shop serves 'Utonjiru'? Please tell me♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh...? What did you say?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh~! As expected of you, Mr. President. To partake of such a precious celebratory dish, one must have a fitting reason, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If you simply must know...」
I didn't even ask, though... Maybe she just wants someone to talk to?

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's a little embarrassing, but just for you, I'll make a confession.」

name: Synn
message: 「A-A confession?! Ba-dump, ba-dump!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The truth is, I...」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「For a little while now, I've been having a fight with a friend who has absolutely no connection to you whatsoever, Mr. President.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「She was being so stubborn and wouldn't listen to a word I said...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「But the one who was really being hard-headed and failing to understand her friend was actually me.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「After a lot happened, she and I finally made up. And it's all thanks to everyone on the Student Council and Jeeves♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Riesling-san aside, I didn't really do anything, you know?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Being in the Crusaders teaches me so much. Thank you very much.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... You're welcome.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now then, this is where 'uton-jiru' makes its grand entrance!!」
W-Why!?

name: Lolotte
message: 「You think so too, don't you, President? Then let us go slurp up some 'uton-jiru' together to commemorate making up♪」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What kind of food is that?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It is completely unknown! Therefore, there is no doubt that it is a legendary delicious dish!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I had my eye on the Treasurer's family place, thinking they might have it, but they didn't sell it...」
Well, of course it wouldn't be on the menu.
More importantly, damn it, Nanaka--you didn't correct Lolotte just because it was too much trouble, did you?

name: Lolotte
message: 「In my imagination, it's a soup with a sweet-and-savory Japanese dashi broth, a sharp kick of sansho pepper, and thickened with potato starch.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「On top of that, I imagine it has noodles similar to soba, yet with a crisp, fibrous bite, piled high with plenty of chicken toppings.」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That actually sounds delicious...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Synn-sama, get a hold of yourself!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah!? N-No, wait... Listen closely, Lolotte, okay? To 'shun'--」

name: Riesling
message: 「Hmph.」
Leaping gracefully from the window of a nearby shop, Riesling-san lands right in front of Lolotte.

name: Riesling
message: 「Leave the charging of Milady's cellphone to this butler, Riesling Tooyama.」

name: Riesling
message: 「You have a call from Amyrina-sama.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you kindly, Jiiya.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hello, yes?」
Lolotte looks flustered. I can't make out the words coming from the other end of the phone, but from the faint tone of voice leaking through, I can tell it's a girl.
Is this girl named Amyrina a friend of hers?

name: Lolotte
message: 「'Save the celebratory make-up dinner until after exams are over? I've prepared reference books and practice problems, so come back and study'?」
S-She's a friend who really cares about Lolotte!

name: Lolotte
message: 「Why are you being so mean to me!? That's it, we're done! Our friendship is over!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!?」

name: Synn
message: 「I told you not to hang up the phone!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「W-Where am I supposed to vent this pent-up anger? Rumble, rumble, rumble」

name: Synn
message: 「Just take it out on studying for your tests」

name: Synn
message: 「...Lolotte, could you take me to your mansion? That way, we can look into 'Uton Soup'」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh? Does the Rosenkreuz family hold the key to unlocking the secret?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah, or rather, it'll become clear once we study modern Japanese」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Understood. Let us go. And then I shall brag all about it to that heartless Amyrina. Exciting, exciting」

name: Riesling
message: 「The car is ready. This way, please」
In the end, I wound up helping Lolotte make up for the second time and study for her tests.
Even though we're in different grades, it's a good opportunity to review the basics.
